description: Manual source-grounded retrieval labels; not expert reviewed, exhaustive relevance judgments, clinical validation or answer-generation tests. Twelve positives and three unsupported controls. Expected IDs and quotes are checked against the read-only local chunks artifact.

cases.question: 查找桂枝汤原方的五味组成，以及古书中的煎服步骤。
cases.rationale: The clause contains the named formula, its five ingredients and preparation; later same-name mentions are distractors.

cases.question: 查古文：发汗之后口渴想喝水，又见排尿不畅和轻微发热，五苓散在哪条被提及？

evidence.quote: 小便不利、微热、消渴者，五苓散主之。

cases.question: 只检索文献：外在病证还未解除，心下水气，干呕发热又咳，哪段说明小青龙汤？

心下有水气，咳有微喘、发热不渴

伤寒若吐若下后，七八日不解

cases.question: 2026年甘草治疗心律失常随机双盲试验的样本量、风险比和DOI是多少？
cases.rationale: Hard negative shares herb vocabulary but asks for modern trial metadata outside the classical evidence. Generic herb retrieval cannot support the requested trial.

cases.question: Cloudflare Pages的2026年免费套餐每月构建次数是多少？
cases.rationale: Out-of-domain service-pricing question; classical passages are not evidence, even if lexical overlap retrieves something.

cases.rationale: Synthetic uppercase-letter token with zero character-bigram overlap in the current corpus probes arbitrary fallback retrieval. This is not a medical question or patient identifier.
